description: This file defines a React component named 'Tests' which serves as a page in a test management frontend application. It manages the search functionality for tests, conditional rendering based on URL parameters, and includes components for listing tests, viewing test details, and creating new tests. It also incorporates access control for certain UI elements.

methods.name: Tests
methods.description: React functional component that renders the test management page, with search, test grid, test detail, and test creation functionalities.
